problem: core.autocrlf is true for this repository (set outside the repo) and .gitattributes pinned only public/data, so a plain git worktree add rewrote every audit/*.json to CRLF and the raw-byte sha256 pins stopped matching

beforeTheFix.consequence: apply-entity-cleanup.mjs refused to run, so the chain could not complete on a clean checkout of its own tree

fix: .gitattributes now pins LF for audit/**/*.{json,jsonl,md,csv,tsv,txt}, identity/*.json and the evidence package
scopeDerivedFrom: apply-entity-cleanup.mjs POST_APPROVAL_SETS — Owner Ruling 3, lane B families 4-5

blobImpact.conclusion: no stored blob is normalised by these rules; the three pinned artifacts checked hash to the same blob before and after

afterTheFix.workaroundApplied: none — the repo-local core.autocrlf override was removed first, leaving the inherited true in effect
